name: Basket Gate
story: Pip has packed the meadow picnic, but the hedge gates open only for parcels with the right outline. Turn each toy basket and line it up with the gap.
objective: Deliver five picnic parcels before the garden closes.
twist: Friendly hedge openings have spare space. Every opening comes from your parcel, so a fitting turn always exists.
rule: Rotate and align the floating parcel to fit the opening, then send it through. Five deliveries win; four bonks close the route.
controls: E/Q: turn parcel · Arrows/WASD: align on wall · Space: send now · Or wait for the gate
opening_hint: E/Q turns the parcel; arrows align its outline with the gap. Space sends it through.
fail_text: The gates have closed. Try this route again!
